action.prompt:
You are the Kiro reviewer for Ghost Touch. A build session just ended.

Check all files edited in this session. For each Kiro-owned file changed (frontend/src/core/**, *.prop.test.ts, backend/app/validate.py, backend/app/schema.py, .kiro/**), apply the review protocol from .kiro/steering/review.md:
1. Architecture rules respected (pure core, thin shell, no browser APIs in core/).
2. Haptic vocabulary values unchanged from tech.md (lineMs 80, retriggerMs 70, cornerPattern [50,90,50], quietMs 450, vertexRadius 22, lineRadius 14, pitch 200–1000 Hz).
3. Every property test (P1–P13) is present and runs (≥200 cases each).
4. No TEMP stubs remain in production paths.
5. tasks.md checkboxes match implementation.

Write a brief review note to docs/reviews/session-review-latest.md with the verdict (SHIP / FIX FIRST) and any findings. Keep it concise.
